title: SLM-SS: Token-Based Speech Separation with Speech Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27785v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech separation (SS) has witnessed substantial progress in recent years with the advent of neural network-based methods, achieving notable improvements on signal-level evaluation metrics. Existing speech separation systems are mostly optimized with signal-level objectives, and often yield outputs that are acceptable in waveform metrics but suboptimal for intelligibility-sensitive downstream tasks. To address this gap, we propose SLM-SS, a token-based generative speech separation framework that models multi-talker mixtures with speech language models. We first discretize clean speech into multi-codebook token sequences with neural codecs and serialize multi-speaker targets via Serialized Output Training (SOT). translated_title: SLM-SS：基于语音语言模型的令牌化语音分离
translated_abstract: 近年来，随着基于神经网络方法的出现，语音分离（SS）取得了长足进展，在信号级评估指标上获得了显著提升。然而，现有的语音分离系统大多以信号级目标进行优化，其输出虽然在波形指标上表现可接受，但对于可懂度敏感的下游任务而言往往并非最优。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了SLM-SS，一个基于令牌的生成式语音分离框架，它利用语音语言模型对多说话人混合语音进行建模。我们首先使用神经编解码器将干净语音离散化为多码本令牌序列，并通过序列化输出训练（SOT）对多说话人目标进行序列化。编码器-解码器结构的自回归语音语言模型预测零阶序列，以确定说话人顺序和粗略的语言内容；随后，非自回归模块对更高阶的残差码本进行精细化处理。
tldr: 该论文提出了SLM-SS，一个基于语音语言模型的令牌级生成式语音分离框架，通过神经编解码器将语音离散化为多码本令牌、借助SOT序列化多说话人目标，先由自回归模型确定说话人顺序与语言内容，再由非自回归模块细化残差码本，从而生成更利于可懂度敏感下游任务的分离语音。
en_tdlr: SLM-SS is a token-based generative speech separation framework that uses speech language models to discretize speech into multi-codebook tokens with SOT serialization, where an autoregressive model establishes speaker ordering and coarse linguistic content, and a non-autoregressive module refines residual codebooks to produce separation outputs better suited for intelligibility-sensitive downstream tasks.
